statements.t: We plan to initiate the INTEGR8 global clinical trial in the first half of 2027 and provide initial clinical data, including safety, tolerability, and FVIII functional activity data, in the second half of 2027.”
The Company also intends to expand the INTEGR8 trial to hemophilia treatment centers beyond the U.S., subject to clinical clearances in additional jurisdictions.
The Company anticipates that the runway will support operations into 2028.
Going forward, the Company intends to continue to expand its pipeline by leveraging its proprietary genetic editing capabilities in site-specific deletion, insertion and correction.

MGX-001, the Company’s lead, wholly owned development program in hemophilia A, has demonstrated a preclinical profile with best-in-class treatment potential, including targeted genome editing and durable gene expression in a one-time treatment.

The Company is also currently pursuing indications leveraging the same site-specific large gene integration at the albumin locus as used in MGX-001 and partnered assets targeting cardiometabolic diseases.

dropped.t: The Company remains on track to submit an IND application in the fourth quarter of 2026 for the global clinical program, and subject to regulatory clearance, initiate clinical trials in 2027.
